title: 无法接入阿里云Qwen
body:
### 📦 Platform

Official Preview

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

client db (lobe-chat image)

### 📌 Version

v1.127.1

### 💻 Operating System

macOS

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

无法接入阿里云平台

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

在语言模型中选择阿里云Qwen，不勾选任何模型，输入API KEY后点击检查链接。返回：
{
  "error": {
    "message": "The model `qwen-flash-latest` does not exist or you do not have access to it.",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": null,
    "code": "model_not_found"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1",
  "provider": "qwen"
}

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

{
  "error": {
    "message": "The model `qwen-flash-latest` does not exist or you do not have access to it.",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": null,
    "code": "model_not_found"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1",
  "provider": "qwen"
}

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
